title: Read primary and secondary repositories concurrently
userIntent: Resolve both repository identities and issue concurrent public reads against the same immutable README in each repository.

intendedBehavior: Independent reads for two registered repositories may execute concurrently and return the correct snapshot content.
behavioralInvariants: Each read is explicitly bound to its captured repository identity.
regressionRisks: Concurrent calls cross repository identity or serialize through unintended global state.
